changeSet.author: logos
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE nightly_benchmarks ADD COLUMN window_start time(0), ADD COLUMN window_end time(0), ADD CONSTRAINT nightly_rotation_window_valid CHECK ( (window_start IS NULL AND window_end IS NULL) OR ( window_start IS NOT NULL AND window_end IS NOT NULL AND window_start < time '24:00' AND window_end < time '24:00' AND EXTRACT(SECOND FROM window_start) = 0 AND EXTRACT(SECOND FROM window_end) = 0 AND window_end - window_start > interval '10 minutes' ) );

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE nightly_benchmarks DROP CONSTRAINT nightly_rotation_window_valid, DROP COLUMN window_start, DROP COLUMN window_end;
